scripts.build: pnpm run rsts && pnpm --filter @imgo/minifier-js build && pnpm --filter @imgo/minifier-js build:wasm && pnpm --filter @imgo/web build
scripts.test:rust: cargo test -p imgo-shared --lib && cargo test -p minifier --lib
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rust
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt -p minifier minifier-js minifier-cli imgo-shared IMGo && npx prettier "**/{src,js-src}/**/*.{ts,tsx,scss,css}" -w
scripts.lint: cargo fmt -p minifier minifier-js minifier-cli imgo-shared IMGo --check && npm run tscheck && npm run oxlint
scripts.init:src: cd deps/libheif-sys && git reset --hard && git apply ../libheif-sys.patch && cd ../libde265 && git reset --hard && git apply ../libde265.patch && cd ../libheif && git reset --hard && git apply ../libheif.patch && cd ../jpegxl-rs && git reset --hard && git apply ../jpegxl-rs.patch
scripts.init: git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm run init:src && npm run rsts && pnpm install && pnpm --filter @imgo/minifier-js build && pnpm --filter @imgo/minifier-js build:wasm
scripts.create-patches: cd deps/libheif-sys && git diff > ../libheif-sys.patch && cd ../libheif && git diff > ../libheif.patch&& cd ../jpegxl-rs && git diff > ../jpegxl-rs.patch
